newsitem.title: USA: Harman International names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: Harman International names new CFO.

text.p: Harman International Industries Inc said Wednesday it promoted Frank Meredith to the position of vice president-finance and administration and chief financial officer, effective February 1, 1997.
The company said Meredith has been with Harman International since 1985.
During that time, the company said, he held various positions in the finance, tax and legal areas and most recently was vice president, general counsel.
The company said its president Bernard Girod had the position of chief financial officer until Meredith's promotion.
